'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***At least three people are killed and 13 others are injured in a [[missile strike|rocket attack]] on a residential area in [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/6/14/russia-ukraine-live-three-killed-in-odesa-missile-strike (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Adam Delimkhanov]], a Russian-[[Chechens|Chechen]] member of the [[State Duma]], is reportedly injured in Ukraine. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65900913 (BBC News)]
*[[2022–2023 North Kosovo crisis]]
**[[Kosovo–Serbia relations]]
***[[Serbian Armed Forces|Serbian forces]] detain three [[Kosovo Police]] officers, accusing them of illegally crossing the border. [[Prime Minister of Kosovo|Kosovan Prime Minister]] [[Albin Kurti]] denies the Serbian claims, saying that the officers were arrested 300 metres inside Kosovan territory, and demands their immediate release. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2023-06-14/serbias-security-forces-detain-three-kosovo-police-officers-kosovo-official-says (U.S. News and World Report)] 
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2023 Northern Syria clashes]]
***Ten [[Syrian Democratic Forces|SDF]] fighters and five [[Syrian Arab Army|Syrian soldiers]] are killed by [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]] [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/301454/ (SOHR)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Geneina#Killing of Khamis Abakar|Killing of Khamis Abakar]]
***The [[List of current state governors in Sudan|state governor]] of [[West Darfur]], [[Khamis Abakar]], is killed in [[Geneina]] after being abducted by armed men shortly after accusing the [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF) of committing [[genocide]] in the [[States of Sudan|state]]. The RSF denies killing Abakar, blaming "outlaws" for his death. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-65914569 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Manipur violence]]
**Nine people are killed in ethnic clashes in [[Manipur]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/14/nine-killed-in-new-ethnic-violence-in-indias-manipur (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Two [[Islamic State]] operatives, including Abu Zacharia, a leader of [[Abu Sayyaf]], are killed in separate operations by joint security forces in [[Marawi]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/6/14/ISIS-Southeast-Asia-leader-killed-in-Marawi-encounter-AFP.html (CNN Philippines)] [https://news.abs-cbn.com/video/news/06/14/23/2-terrorists-killed-in-lanao-del-norte (ABS-CBN News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[European Commission]] orders [[Google]] to sell off portions of its advertising services in order to comply with anti-competitive practices and threatens to fine the company up to 10% of its global turnover. Google, which relies on advertising services for up to 79% of its revenue, says that it will appeal the order. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/eu-antitrust-regulators-charge-google-anti-competitive-adtech-practices-2023-06-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Minister of Finance (Canada)|Finance Minister]] [[Chrystia Freeland]] announces that [[Canada]] is suspending its relations with the [[China]]-based [[Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank]] while [[Department of Finance Canada|her department]] conducts an investigation into allegations of the [[Chinese Communist Party]]'s influence over the organization. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/canada-freezes-ties-china-led-aiib-probes-allegations-communist-domination-3562371 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Messenia migrant boat disaster]]
**At least 78 people die and 100 others are rescued after a [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|boat carrying refugees and migrants]] from [[Libya]] to [[Italy]] [[capsize]]s near [[Pylos]], [[Messenia]], [[Greece]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/14/seventeen-dead-after-boat-carrying-migrants-capsizes-off-greece (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
***[[President of Indonesia|Indonesian President]] [[Joko Widodo]] announces that [[Indonesia|the country]] will end their [[COVID-19]] emergency within the next two weeks and transition into [[Endemic COVID-19|endemic]] status. [https://en.antaranews.com/news/285063/indonesia-ready-to-advance-to-covid-19-endemic-stage-president-jokowi (Antara)] [https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2023/06/14/jokowi-to-lift-covid-19-emergency-status-within-two-weeks.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Fiji–New Zealand relations]]
**[[Fiji]] and [[New Zealand]] sign a [[defence pact]] in [[Suva]], Fiji, which includes military cooperation and [[humanitarian aid]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/14/new-zealand-and-fiji-strike-defence-deal-amid-rising-pacific-tensions (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Japan military facility shooting]]
**Two [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|soldiers]] are killed and another is injured during a [[live fire exercise]] at a [[Military training area|training area]] in [[Gifu]], [[Japan]], as a [[Military recruitment|recruit]] opens fire at them. The suspect is apprehended and charged with the [[attempted murder]] of a soldier. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3224010/japan-soldier-kills-2-wounds-1-after-opening-fire-comrades-army-training-range (AFP via ''SCMP'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65900041 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
***[[Mayor of Miami]], [[Florida]], [[Francis Suarez]] files for candidacy as a [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] in the [[2024 United States presidential election]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/06/14/us/politics/francis-suarez-2024-election-republican.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*At the [[International Society for Stem Cell Research]]'s annual meeting in [[Boston]], [[Massachusetts]], United States, [[developmental biologist]] [[Magdalena Żernicka-Goetz]] reveals that American and British researchers have generated the world's first [[Synthetic embryo|synthetic]] [[human embryo]]-like structures using [[stem cell]]s. Żernicka-Goetz suggests that the findings could provide insights into the [[causes of miscarriage]]s. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/06/14/health/human-model-embryo/index.html (CNN)]
*Astronomers report that the presence of [[phosphate]]s on [[Enceladus]], moon of the planet [[Saturn]], has been detected, completing the discovery of all the basic chemical ingredients for life on the moon. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/06/14/science/enceladus-phosphorus-life.html (New York Times)]
